effects.description: Pending keeps the foreground dialog loading and schedules another check without delivery.
Two pending statuses are followed by one ready delivery after exactly three checks.
Closing the foreground dialog immediately clears its loading state.
A pending response arriving after foreground close cannot schedule another check.
A ready response arriving after foreground close cannot deliver the file.
An old-generation ready response remains inert while the reopened generation is loading.
Only the reopened generation delivers, exactly once.
The active background export also supports repeated pending statuses before one delivery.
Closing the background panel prevents its workspace-owned preparation from completing.
When explicitly authorized, background close clears loading and suppresses every retry and delivery.
